BOARD OBSERVER AGREEMENT

This Board Observer Agreement is between Kestrel Labs, Inc. (the "Company") and Halden Ventures LP (the "Investor").

1. Observer. Investor may designate one person to attend all meetings of the board of directors as a non-voting observer.

2. Materials. The Company will give the observer the materials it gives the directors.

3. Exclusion. The Company may exclude the observer to preserve attorney-client privilege or to avoid a conflict of interest.

4. Confidentiality. The observer will keep all board information confidential.
